learning_outcomes.text: Know and understand the behavior of biological neurons.
Effectively model and represent different data sets in intelligent systems.
Build useful systems for applying, classifying, recognizing, and providing data similar to training data.
Score knowledge and practical skills in the use of tools, methods, and techniques in the field of artificial intelligence.

syllabus_topics: Foundations and interpretation of biological functioning prototypes for an explanation of classical methods and computational techniques in the field of computational intelligence
Latest scientific discoveries in the field of artificial intelligence on the associative method of formation of knowledge
Construction of interactive artificial intelligence systems
Different models of biological neurons used in calculations and research
